title: Studio report Properties: "Add item" (Order, joined blocks) and a chart type picked before its axes autosave an incomplete report (422), so later edits are refused; hold them as the dashboard lists are held after #27459
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ① product defect, measured by QA run #27441 and recorded as step 7 of #27459. It is split out here because PR #27784 (`Fixes #27459`) covers only the dashboard path, which is the one named by that card's title, reproduction and QA clause.
Business reason: a report author who adds a sort row, a joined block or picks a chart type first sees the red "Changes not saved: the server refused this draft" banner. Every later edit to the report is then refused too and lost on reload. The Interfaces pillar holds such edits elsewhere.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (Studio, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "report Properties Add item 422 order.0.by held incomplete chart xAxis yAxis" → 1 hit (#3752, unrelated chart props). "Studio report autosave empty item refused 422 held until filled" → #27459 (the dashboard half, this card's parent), #26705 and #26845 (departure guards). None of them covers this.

## What happens (QA run #27441, card #27459 step 7)

On the report Properties panel in the Studio Interfaces pillar:

- **Order → "Add item"**: the request is `PUT …?mode=draft` with `order:[{}]`, and the server answers 422 `order.0.by`.
- **joined report → "Add item"**: `blocks:[{}]` gets a 422.
- **Chart type "bar" picked before the axes**: 422 `chart.xAxis` / `chart.yAxis`.

Each one shows the refusal banner instead of holding the edit. The next autosave sends the same body and is refused again.

## Seam

`spec:ReportSchema` → renderer `StudioDesignSurface` `InterfacesPillar` `leafIncomplete`. The gate today is `leafType === 'dashboard'`. PR #27784 adds `listItemHeldInput(body, schema, skip)` and `heldListItem(...)` in `metadataError.ts`. These take any spec schema, so the two list cases (Order and joined blocks) should be able to reuse them against `ReportSchema`, with the report form for the labels.

The chart case is not a list item. It is a nested object (`chart`) refused only for its unset `xAxis`/`yAxis`. Either generalise the "every issue lands on an unset input" rule to that object, or hold it separately. The implementer decides and says which in the PR.

## Expected

The same rule as the dashboard after PR #27784:

- A report the spec refuses **only** because a just-added item, or the chart, has unset inputs is held and not sent. A neutral line names the input ("By on item #1 of “Order” needs a value"). **Show me** opens the report's properties at that list, and Publish refuses while the edit is held.
- Once the input is filled, the next autosave sends every edit kept in the meantime.
- An item refused for a value it already holds is sent, and its refusal shows as before.
- ⛔ No client-side list of required inputs: the judge is `ReportSchema` itself.

## Acceptance

- A measured repro of each of the three cases on current `main` first. A case that no longer reproduces is named and dropped.
- Unit pins against the real `ReportSchema` (held / not held / finished-but-wrong), the same shape as `metadataError.heldListItem-27459.test.ts`.
- Show me reaches the list even when its form section is collapsed (this is the dashboard's residual from PR #27784 Acceptance notes; fix it here only if it costs the same code).

Related: #27459, PR #27784, #26705.
Size: S/M.
